checks.label: Release integrity
checks.description: Check every file of the current atlas release (latest.json) against its manifest digests.
checks.summary: All 36 files of release uz-20260929T143815620Z match their digests. It replaces the 24 September release, which no longer described the cube after the TerraClimate v1.1 rebase.

checks.label: Upstream topology
checks.description: Recalculate Syr Darya level 7 upstream membership and area.

checks.label: Raster to basin climate
checks.description: Recalculate one basin-month of ERA5-Land temperature and precipitation.
checks.summary: One January 2003 basin-month agreed within 0.01 units.

checks.label: Monthly record and provisional estimate
checks.description: Recalculate AET history, the January 2026 provisional estimate and its 2020–2025 holdout for basin 4121292070.
checks.summary: 2025 AET sums to 341.846 mm and matches the chart within display rounding; the January 2026 estimate reproduces exactly. Holdout RMSE 13.8 mm/month against 16.6 for a seasonal baseline.

checks.label: Drought record
checks.description: Check the served water-year totals, 1991–2020 normal, anomalies and SPI-12 for basin 4121292070 with an independent gamma estimator.
checks.summary: 34 water-year totals match the v1.1 monthly record within 0.001 mm; the 683.77 mm normal, 65 anomalies and 65 SPI-12 values reproduce within 0.001. Water year 2025: −30.4%, SPI −1.78.

checks.label: Catchment statistics
checks.description: Retrace the 89-basin catchment of 4121292070 and recalculate its area, relief, shape and monthly coverage.
checks.summary: 89 basins and 11,885.5 km² retraced; relief and circularity reproduce; precipitation covers 100% of the catchment. MODIS snow cover ends in December 2024 here.

checks.label: Independent estimates vs monthly record
checks.description: Recompute 2003–2025 TerraClimate v1.1 normals for all 7,445 basins and compare them with the published independent estimates.
checks.summary: All 72 TerraClimate-based estimates are re-derived from v1.1, the release the monthly record uses; recomputed normals match them exactly (0.0% median difference, against −9.6% for the earlier v1.0 estimates, which stay on record).

checks.label: Pskem model validation
checks.description: Refit the published retrospective model and check the held-out baseline.
checks.summary: Published fit reproduced; held-out RMSE exceeded the climatology baseline.

findings.title: Drought and outlook
findings.text: For basin 4121292070 the served drought record is consistent with the v1.1 monthly data and its SPI-12 reproduces with an independent estimator. This checks the arithmetic and the source, not whether TerraClimate itself is right; no rain gauge was compared.

findings.title: River flow
findings.text: At 45 CA-discharge gauges, water-year flow has followed catchment precipitation closely (median r = 0.74; a 10% precipitation shortfall went with about 12% less flow), except where glaciers feed the river. Measured flow exceeds TerraClimate precipitation at a quarter of the gauges, so its mountain precipitation is too low. ERA5-Land runoff is the closer of the two runoff products (1.2 times measured, against 0.4 for TerraClimate). Records end by 2021.

findings.title: Monthly and recent climate
findings.text: Monthly values are gridded estimates (TerraClimate v1.1) and reanalysis (ERA5-Land), not field measurements. Months after December 2025 are provisional estimates from ERA5-Land; their error is a river-system holdout figure, not a basin-specific interval.

findings.title: Independent estimates
findings.text: Precipitation, evapotranspiration, soil-water and moisture-index normals in the Independent estimates tab now come from TerraClimate v1.1, like the Monthly tab, catchment statistics and reports. Before 30 September they were on v1.0 and about 10% wetter.

findings.title: Catchment statistics
findings.text: Membership, area, relief and shape reproduce exactly for the checked catchment. MODIS snow cover is withdrawn from trend use and ends in December 2024 for this catchment.

findings.title: Model
findings.text: The Pskem reconstruction had higher held-out error than a training-month climatology baseline. It is retrospective; forecast skill is not established.
